gaps.sentence: I need this report ___ by noon, not five.
gaps.explanation: Need + object + past participle: the report is typed by somebody else (causative-like).

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.

gaps.sentence: He's getting his eyes ___ next week.
gaps.explanation: Causative get + object + past participle: getting his eyes tested (by an optician).

gaps.sentence: The new policy ___ (CRITICISE) sharply since it was announced.
gaps.explanation: 'Since' + continuing result: present perfect passive has been criticised.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.

gaps.sentence: Over two hundred bird species ___ (record) in the valley this spring.
gaps.explanation: 'This spring' is an open time frame, so present perfect passive: have been + recorded.

gaps.sentence: The ambush ___ (plan) by someone with intimate knowledge of the valley.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive (had been planned) stresses completion before the ambush; was planned is also acceptable.
'She hates' takes a gerund; the passive gerund is 'being watched'.
